keys alpha and holds colour per packed order with native rounding into owned tight planes without mutating padded input
rejects unsupported layouts, budgets, malformed storage, settings and cancellation explicitly
plans colorkey and colorhold on linear, graph and actor paths, refuses parse errors before frames and refuses runtime commands

matches native colorkey and colorhold soft blends across packed RGBA orders and every path on linux-x64
matches native colorkey and colorhold CLI rawvideo and framecrc on the linear, actor and timed paths, including implicit conversions
matches native colorkey and colorhold filter_complex branches on the graph path in rawvideo and framecrc

details: 912 hard-key kernel cases (3 frames, rawvideo bytes and timestamps) vs native -vf: 4 packed orders x 6 sizes x 38 descriptions
994 linux-x64-gated soft-blend cases: 864 kernel, 72 CLI (linear/actor/timed), 8 graph (16 files), 2 replay streams, 48 float-reciprocal boundary cases
336 CLI outputs (rawvideo and framecrc, with and without -ss/-t) via the media backend and the timed producer and pull schedulers, including yuv420p/rgb24/gray conversions with -cpuflags 0
32 filter_complex graph cases with two outputs each (64 files)
8 stream cases: 6 replay executions and 2 multi-input CLI joins
6 native refusals compared by status (256 - host errno), message and absence of output; plus 2 EdgeFFmpeg-only refusals (enable=, random)

unsupported: rgba64le and bgra64le frames (no storage; no accepted source negotiates them)
expression-valued, suffixed or constant similarity and blend values
random and platform-undefined colours (parseColor code unsupported)
enable= timelines (native supports the generic timeline) and runtime commands
native EINVAL (234) and ERANGE (222) exit statuses: EdgeFFmpeg filter parse failures exit 1

sharedEditsNeeded: Exit-status channel for filter parse errors: the CLI frontends wrap every video filter parse failure as an exit-1 ExecutionError, so native AVERROR(EINVAL) (256-EINVAL, 234 on Linux) for invalid colours and AVERROR(ERANGE) (222) for out-of-range AV_OPT_TYPE_FLOAT values cannot be reproduced from an owned file. The refusals happen before any output with native messages; the reject test pins the native statuses and EdgeFFmpeg exit 1.
notes: No shared edit beyond the four registry lines was made.
Reference built in the sandbox with --allow-unpinned-reference (differs from the linux-x64 pin; build-metadata asserts commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm).
Node 24.22.3 installed from the nodejs.org tarball (sha256 checked; install time not recorded). The sandbox had Node 22.23.5 and bootstrap requires 24+.
Linux gate is a precaution: at depth 8 every double product and sum is an exact integer, so fused and unfused evaluation agree; no macOS difference measured.
Mutations caught: hold rounding +128 (6 tests), round instead of trunc (1), >= hard key (1), double instead of float 1.f/blend (1, via boundary cases), rgba map for bgra (3).
Native picks argb from every non-packed negotiation source, including yuvj420p/422p/444p; registry examples include a bare form (gray source picks argb) and explicit format= stages.
